mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate (above 5%) compresses equity valuations by increasing discount rates applied to future cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS >5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL reading above 314.5 indicates accelerating inflation, prompting the Fed to delay rate cuts and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL >314.5, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in payrolls signals a strong labor market, which typically precedes corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative or flat 5-day returns in >60% of triggered instances (UNRATE decline and PAYEMS increase), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, rising housing starts indicate sustained consumer confidence and strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in >60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in monthly payrolls reflects robust labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in >60% of instances when PAYEMS rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production reading below 100.5 indicates a contraction in manufacturing, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in >60% of instances when INDPRO <100.5, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL >314.0) and a stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS >=5.0%) signals persistent inflationary pressures, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in >60% of instances when CPIAUCSL >314.0 AND FEDFUNDS >=5.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a post-recession recovery phase, rising retail sales above the 12-month moving average indicate strengthening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in >60% of instances during post-recession recovery when RSAFS rises above 12-month MA, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
